info.title: Distru Public API - Purchasing
info.description: Phase 0.5 audited 2026-05-21. Re-probed 2026-05-26 against 563 live records — purchase_datetime, delivery_datetime, billing_location, shipping_location, creator, owner, completion_datetime, and the four cost_per_unit/total_cost fields claimed by earlier docs do NOT exist on /purchases. See categories/purchase-orders.md for the verified 12-top-level + 11-line-item shape.

get.description: List purchases. Page size 500. NO creator/owner/billing_location/shipping_location fields on response — Distru POs are markedly leaner than orders/invoices.

parameters.name: order_datetime
parameters.description: Comma-range. NOTE: filter is `order_datetime`, NOT `purchase_datetime` — the wire field is order_datetime despite the resource being /purchases.

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description: Title Case INPUT — response returns UPPERCASE. CANCELED single-L.

post.description: UPSERT. SERVER-SIDE IMMUTABILITY: cannot edit a purchase whose status has advanced past 'Pending' — returns HTTP 400. Non-sparse updates.

400.description: Returned when attempting to edit past Pending, or validation failure

200.description: 12-field purchase with inline items[] and charges[]

post.description: WRITE-ONLY. QB account type must be 'Bank' or 'Credit Card' (differs from /invoices payments).
